newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian colliery to re-open after accident.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian colliery to re-open after accident.

text.p: Oakbridge Pty Ltd said it would recommence mining operations at Gretley colliery, near Newcastle in the Australian state of New South Wales, on Thursday.
This followed a shutdown of the mine following an accident on November 14 when four miners were killed and others narrowly escaped death when floodwaters rushed into workings 120 metres underground.
Richard Porteous, manager of Gretley colliery, said in a statement of condolences to the families of miners involved in last week's accident that production would resume.

Before the accident, Gretley colliery was scheduled to produce 1.3 million tonnes of coal in calendar 1996 representing about seven percent of the 18 million tonnes which Oakbridge, 42 percent-owned by the U.S. Cyprus-Amax group, produces each year.
